title: gentianella ignea
intro: Gentianella ignea, commonly known as the mountain gentian or alpine gentian, is a flowering plant species in the gentian family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including digestive issues and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve symptoms of fever, and act as an expectorant to ease respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of Gentianella ignea include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
